content: Kuhika kwa Uhuke gwa Chapanga
Lichiko lya Pendekochite pulihikita, bhibhakanyeketii Yecho bhakakonganike pamonga.
Papalapala bhando bhajhakulijhoha lilobhe kuhumi kunane kwa Chapanga ngita kimbonga, na kutweleya nyumba jhoha jhubhakatamite.
Peniya, ijhakupitila ilebhe ngita ndetelekana ya mwotu, na yenio ijhakupechengana panane jha kila mundo.
Bhando bhoha bhajhakuhindililwa Uhuke gwa Chapanga, na kila jhumo ajhakutumbuu kulonge, kila jhumo lugha yono ngita Uhuke gwa Chapanga chatangatila.
Kwenio ku Yeluchalemo, pakibha na Akayahude bhubhakibha bhahobholila Chapanga bhibhahumila ilambo yoha ya pannema.
Pubhajhohina lilobhe lyenio, lilongo lya bhando lijhakukonganika pamonga. Bhoha bhajhakukangacha nhwalo kila mundo akajhohine chakajhake bhakalongela milondole bha Chapanga.
Bhajhakuhechuka na kukangacha bhalongila, “Bho, bhando bhamba bhoha bhibhalonge naha bhabhelukii pa Galilaya pano jhe?
Ngoheno ibhii bhole kila jhumo pakate jhito ijhoha ilonge chukajha?
Bhange bhahumila ku kilambo chu ku Pasiya na ku Mediya na ku Elamo na ku Misopotamiya na ku Yudeya na ku Kapadokiya na ku Ponto na ku Asiya,
na bhange kuhumii ku Fuligiya na ku Pamfiliya na ku Michile na ku Libiya ibhii pahina na ku Kilene, helahela bhange ndi akaghene kuhumii ku Loma.

Na Akayahude na bhando bhange bha ilambo henge bhibhajhingila mu dine jha Akayahude, na bhange bhahumila ku Kulete na Alabiya. Nambo twabhoha twenga twajhohine bhando chibhalongela kwa lugha jhabhe mambu makolongwa gha Chapanga!”
Bhando bhoha bhajhakukangacha, kone bhakonyina, “Mambu ghanga mana jhake nike?”
Nambo bhando bhange bhajhakwatendela chanake bhalongila, “Bhando bhamba bhatehi kulobhela!”
Mabholo gha Petile

Peniya, Petile ajhakujhema pakate jha akatenga bhabhii pamonga na twenga ajhakutumbuu kulonge kanonoha, “Makalongo bhango Akayahude na bhando bhange bhumitama pa Yeluchalemo, deka ninnobholele na unyokanikiya mbone chinilonge.”
Bhando bhamba bhalobhii ndeka, nhwalo ngoheno chaa tato jhu lukela.
Chakaka lijhambu lende ndi lela lalongila jwakibha nnondole jwa Chapanga Yoele:

content.text: Yana hino ingombo na ichikana nabhalongela malobhe ghango,
Chakaka, hilu akatumiche akanalome na akakeghe,
Napabhaha na miyahe, mwotu na lyoi litopaho.
na lubhala mwehe nalubhaha lukele ngita miyahe,
kabula jha kupitila lichiko likolongwa lya ulumbililo gwa Bhambo.
Mundo jhojhoha jwajhopa kwa liina lya Bhambo, nakombolwa.

content: Petile pajhendilila kulonge, “Bhando bha kilambo chu ku Ichilahele nnyokanikiye malobhe ghanga! Yecho jwa ku Nachalete akibha mundo jhuna ukindendeke gwa Chapanga na jwamanyikine kwino kwa ndela jha ikangacho, na nginyililo ya Chapanga yatehila pakate jhino ngita chiumanya.

Yecho akapihitwe kwino nhwalo Chapanga jwenio akapangite njwe Yecho akamulwe mu mabhoko ghino bhibhahenga uhakaho, na mangota nnyakukoma kwa kwaleka bhando bhubhabhiii na uhakaho bhamambe panane jha nchalaba.
Nambo Chapanga ngayokicha Yecho kuhumii ku bhubhawile, akankombwile kuhumi mulipyanda lya kuwegha kwa mana ngaiwechekine jhe kuwegha kuntabhe.
Nhwalo Daude akalongile naha panane jha Yecho.

content.text: nhwalo abhii pahina jhango, nanyukenyuke ndeka.
na kabhele lulime lwango nalukajhula kilulo.
nhwalo namulekii jhe Uhuke gwango ku kilambo cha bhando bhubhawile,
hilu kuneka jwa nyahinyahi jwino abhole.
undweliye luhangano nhwalo mmii pamonga na nenga.’

content: “Makalongo bhango bhu ku Ichilahele, deka ninobholele hotuhotu panane jha tate gwito nkolongwa Daude. Jwenio akawile na kuyelelwa na mambe jhake ibhii pamba kwito ade deleno.
Nambo nhwalo Daude akibha nnondole jwa Chapanga, akamanyite kubhehe Chapanga akanapanikiye kilapo nantenda jhumo pakate jha kibheluko chake kubhehe munahota nkolongwa ngita jwenio Daude.
Daude akalongolile ghughabhona mambu ghanga ghighapalwa kutendwa na Chapanga, ndi palongila panane jha kuyokechwa kwa Kilichitu pala palongila,

content.text: ‘Akalekitwe ndeka ku kilambo cha bhando bhubhawile,

content: Bhahe, Chapanga ndi jwayokicha jwenio Yecho, na twenga ndi jhutulolita mambu gheniya kwa miho ghito.
Yecho patondobhiwa na kutama lubhoko lwalelo lwa Chapanga, ajhakupokela Uhuke gwa Chapanga ngita chatulaghila. Peniya ajhakutujhila jwenio Uhuke na chenie ndi chimukibhona ngoheno na kukijhoha.
Nhwalo Daude jwenio, akatolitwe ndeka kujhenda kunane kwa Chapanga, nambo jwenio akalongile,

content.text: ade natende akamakoko bhino kigoda cha magholo ghino.’

content: “Kwa nhwalo ghongo bhando bhoha bha kilambo chu ku Ichilahele bhipala bhamanye uchakaka Yecho jhumumambite panane jha nchalaba, ndi jwenio Chapanga jwatehile kubhehe Bhambo na Kilichitu Nkomboche!”
Bhahe, bhando pubhajhohina malobhe gheniya, ghakochite kumwojho, bhajhakunkonya Petile na akatenga bhange, “Bho, akalongo bhito, ngoheno tuhenge nike?”

Petile ajhakwajhanguu, “Kila mundo jhumo ajheketele na kuleka uhakaho gwake na abatichwe kwa liina lya Yecho Kilichitu na Chapanga nanekekeya uhakaho gwino. Na mangota napokela lilaghano lya Chapanga ndi Uhuke gwa Chapanga.
Nhwalo, lilaghilo lela lya Chapanga likibha lino, kwa yana hino, na kwa bhando bhoha bhubhabhiii kutale, na kwa kila mundo Bhambo Chapanga gwito nankema.”
Kwa malobhe twe Petile ajhakangamalicha bhando alongila, “Mukikombole kuhumi mu kibheluko chenje kibhoho!”
Bhando bhamahele bhibhajheketile malobhe gha Petile, bhajhakubatichwa. Na lichiko lela bhando elufo itato bhakajhonjekeka mukikunde chela.
Na bhene bhoha bhajhendilila kubholwa na akatenga, bhatamita pamonga ngita lukolo, bhametwila libumunda na bhanyinamila Chapanga pamonga.
Ughome gwa kila lichiko kwa bhibhannyeketii Kilichitu
Kila mundo jhumo ajhakujhingilwa na bhoghohe, nhwalo gwa ikangacho na nginyililo yamahele ibhatehila akatenga bhala.
Bhibhanyeketii bhoha bhatamita pamonga na kujhendelela kubhaghana ilebhe yabhe pamonga.
Bhakibha bhachulwicha ilebhe yabhe na kubhaghana mbijha yabhe kwa kila mundo jhumo ngita chibhapalita.
Bhajhendilila kukongana mu Nyumba jha Chapanga machiko ghoha. Nambo pubhametwila libumunda, bhakonganika munyumba yabhe bhalila yenio kwa kuhangana na mwojho nhuo gwa mbumbu.
Bhajhakunnomba Chapanga, na kupalwa na bhando bhoha. Na kila lichiko Bhambo ajhonjikiya bhando bhibhakombolilwa.
